name: Technology has greatly changed our way of life.
trans: 科技极大地改变了我们的生活方式。

name: The Internet brings great convenience to our daily life.
trans: 互联网给我们的日常生活带来很大便利。

name: Online shopping allows people to buy things without going out.
trans: 网上购物使人们不用出门就能买东西。

name: Mobile payment has become increasingly popular in China.
trans: 移动支付在中国越来越普及。

name: Artificial intelligence is widely used in education, medicine and transportation.
trans: 人工智能广泛应用于教育、医疗和交通领域。

name: Big data helps companies make better decisions.
trans: 大数据帮助公司做出更好的决策。

name: Technological innovation promotes economic development.
trans: 科技创新促进经济发展。

name: Online learning provides students with more learning resources.
trans: 在线学习为学生提供更多学习资源。

name: We should make full use of technology to improve our study efficiency.
trans: 我们应充分利用科技提高学习效率。

name: However, technology also brings some problems.
trans: 然而，科技也带来一些问题。

name: Some young people are addicted to smartphones and online games.
trans: 一些年轻人沉迷于智能手机和网络游戏。

name: Excessive dependence on technology may affect face-to-face communication.
trans: 过度依赖科技可能影响面对面交流。

name: Personal privacy and data security have attracted wide attention.
trans: 个人隐私和数据安全已引起广泛关注。

name: We should protect personal privacy when using the Internet.
trans: 使用互联网时我们应保护个人隐私。

name: Technology should be developed and used in a responsible way.
trans: 应以负责任的方式发展和使用科技。
